patch_list: Grants every in-app purchase for free: tapping Buy fabricates a successful Google Play purchase (remove-ad, gem packs) and feeds it through the billing listener without opening the payment dialog, and granted entitlements are restored on e…
Grants rewarded-ad rewards instantly on tap without watching an ad: the rewarded ad reports ready immediately and show() fires the reward and close callbacks synchronously.
Removes interstitial, app-open and banner ads: nothing is ever loaded or displayed, and any show call resolves the game's ad callbacks instantly so the flow never stalls.
